speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (Shy-Drager Syndrome)

The combination of parkinsonism (rigidity, tremor), autonomic failure (orthostatic hypotension, incontinence), and bulbar/cerebellar signs (slurred speech, gait difficulty) is highly characteristic of MSA. I will request a Brain MRI and Autonomic Function Tests to confirm this.
